name: Can I clean up vomit myself, or should I always hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I clean up vomit myself, or should I always hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small, contained incidents on non-porous surfaces, you might be able to clean vomit yourself using household disinfectants and protective gear. However, for larger spills, those on porous materials like carpet or upholstery, or if biohazards are a concern (e.g., in a public space), professional cleanup is recommended. Professionals have industrial-grade equipment, stronger disinfectants, and proper disposal methods to ensure complete sanitization and odor removal that DIY efforts might miss.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can clean small, non-porous spills yourself, but professionals are recommended for larger areas, porous materials, or biohazard concerns for complete sanitization.
